Deployment and operations

Container deployment

Build and start the complete stack:

docker compose up --build -d

Check service health and application logs:

docker compose ps
docker compose logs -f sqrl
curl http://localhost:8000/api/health

To roll out a new application image, rebuild the sqrl service and recreate it. Keep PostgreSQL and MinIO volumes when preserving application data.

Environment management

Use a deployment-specific environment file. At minimum, configure the database, object storage, CORS origins, and encryption keys. Provider credentials should be scoped to the providers enabled for the deployment. Never commit .env files, access keys, or encryption keys.

Production behavior

When ENVIRONMENT=production:

  • Swagger and ReDoc are disabled by the application.

  • The frontend is served from the same origin as the API.

  • CORS origins should be explicit; credentialed requests must not use *.

  • Logs should be collected from the container and monitored for failed health checks and storage errors.

Documentation build

The source documentation lives under backend/docs/source. Generate the HTML site from the backend directory:

.\generate_docs.ps1

The output is written to backend/docs/_build/html. The generator also refreshes the grouped Python API pages from the backend package.
